title: OPAPRU assures peacekeeping funds, education aid for MILF members

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – The funds for the operation of the Joint Peace and Security Team (JPST) in Mindanao will be available in October, the Office of the Presidential Adviser on Peace, Reconciliation and Unity (OPAPRU) said. The JPST is composed of personnel from the Armed Forces of the Philippines and the Philippine National Police and members of the Bangsamoro Islamic Armed Forces (BIAF), the armed wing of the erstwhile rebel group Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), who have been working together as “comrades-in-arms” to ensure stability in conflict-affected areas in Mindanao.
